sentences.text:
----- 
 For the Petitioner : Mr. Indrajit Sinha, Advocate

For the State : Mr. Abhay Kr. Tiwari, A.P.P.
 ---
05/11.06.2024
 Heard the Parties.

Petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Mahila P.S. Case No. 03 of 2023, registered under Sections 341, 323, 376(2)(n), 406, 420, 427, 504, 506 & 34 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the Court of Ms. Shardha Bhushan, learned Judicial Magistrate, Ranchi.
Petitioner is said to be acquainted with the prosecutrix since 2015, during this period, on pretext of marriage, the petitioner established physical relationship with her.
Thereafter, he refused to marry her.
The present case has been instituted in 2023 after eight years.
It was submitted that the petitioner had transferred money to the prosecutrix on several occasions and when he was demanding the money, this case has been instituted.
It was further submitted that petitioner had instituted a case against the prosecutrix which is Gonda P.S. Case No.29 of 2023 for offence under Sections 406/420/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
Regard being had to the facts and circumstance of the case, I am inclined to extend the privilege of Anticipatory Bail to the petitioner.

He is directed to surrender before the court below within two weeks from the date of receipt/production of copy of this order, and in the event of his arrest or surrender he shall be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/- (Twenty Thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Ms. Shardha Bhushan, learned Judicial Magistrate, Ranchi or his/her successor in connection with Mahila P.S. Case No. 03 of Suryakant Pathak vs The State Of Jharkhand ... ...
